Browser-local tutor runtime

WebLLM 0.2.85, by the MLC team (Apache License 2.0).
https://github.com/mlc-ai/web-llm
This pinned browser bundle was obtained from:
https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/@mlc-ai/web-llm@0.2.85/+esm
The source-map comment was removed; runtime code is unchanged.
The upstream license is included as WEBLLM-LICENSE.txt.

The separately downloaded model is Qwen2.5-Coder-1.5B-Instruct,
by the Qwen team (Apache License 2.0). Model weights are not
included in this Site's deployment archive.
https://huggingface.co/Qwen/Qwen2.5-Coder-1.5B-Instruct

WebGPU artifacts are supplied by MLC:
https://huggingface.co/mlc-ai/Qwen2.5-Coder-1.5B-Instruct-q4f16_1-MLC
https://huggingface.co/mlc-ai/Qwen2.5-Coder-1.5B-Instruct-q4f32_1-MLC

The application has no remote inference service or paid fallback.
